hints.title: Rule Lookup Grouping
hints.text: Group allowed rules into a mapping from two-character base pairs to list of valid top block characters.

hints.title: Row by Row Construction
hints.text: Build the tier immediately above by selecting a valid top character for each adjacent pair in the current tier.

hints.title: Memoization on Rows
hints.text: Recursively build the next tier character by character. Once the next tier is complete, recurse on it. Memoize failed tier strings to avoid redundant exploration.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: A: average branching factor per pair
complexity.notes: Backtracking with row-level memoization searching for valid pyramid hierarchy.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all possible upper tiers without memoization repeats duplicate failed sub-pyramids.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoizing dead-end tier string configurations prunes exponential duplicate subtrees.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use backtracking to construct intermediate rows and memoize failed row configurations.
